spec2def(ntdsapi.dll ntdsapi.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# ntdsapi.dll is all Rust (ntdsapi-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ntdsapi-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# ntdsapi.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ntdsapi-rust/src/ntdsapi/ntdsapi.rs)
add_cargo_module(ntdsapi ntdsapi-cargo ntdsapi.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE ntdsapi-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
